audience: ecommerce and service businesses who collect customer reviews with Feefo

useCases.title: Find recent low-star reviews
useCases.text: The AI lists service or product reviews with ratings and comment text, newest updates first, and picks out the 1 and 2 star ones for you.

useCases.title: Summarize your average rating and star breakdown
useCases.text: The AI reads the average rating and the 1 to 5 star distribution for service and product reviews, for the last year or for all time.

useCases.title: Rank products by average rating
useCases.text: The AI reads the average star rating per product SKU, optionally with review counts, and shows the best or worst products.

useCases.title: Check your Net Promoter Score responses
useCases.text: The AI reads the NPS summary with promoters, passives and detractors, and lists the NPS responses behind it.

useCases.title: Read a review thread and reply to it
useCases.text: The AI opens a review with its thread of replies, then publishes a public reply after you confirm the wording. It can also email the customer.
